steps.content: Hecate explores one "nightmare" after another, but they are nothing more than fragments of daily life. Things like work, relationships, watching a horror film, or simply being pinned down by a fat cat.
These mild nightmares can't bring power to her Nightmare, but they do provide a sense of peace.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Although I can't regain my power, maybe this world is safer for Chief.
There are happy crowds, laughter and joy all around.
But in the horizon, at the distant edge of the dream realm, Hecate sees a foreboding shadow.
